content: Hey, Jeffrey! Why don't you take this pensonality survey? I'll tell you what kind of person you are.
I'm the kind of person who doesn't like personality surveys.
Oh, come on Jeffrey! I'd read to you.
Alright, go ahead.
Question one says, 'Do you think of yourself as lazy or hard working?' I can probably answer that for you.
OK, I know I am lazy. I don't like to work too hard, especially around the house.
You're right about that. Next question, are you more frequently patient or impatient?
Umm, I'd say, I'm patient, especially when I have to wait for you.
That's true. I guess I don't have to ask the next question. I already know you're fun-loving.
Let me see that. Is that question 3? Yeah, I'd say that's correct. I love dancing. A good party!
And the answer to the next one is stubborn.
What? I'm quite open. I always listen to your suggestions.
I don't think so, but let's go to the next question. Well, you're definitely not talkative.
That's true. It's because I'm so shy.
That's the next question. In most situations are you shy or outgoing?
Definitely shy. I'm not too comfortable meeting new people.
Umm, I don't think that's true but I'll circle it. Let me see, questions 7 asks if you are an organized person.
Umm, no. My desk at work is always a mess.
I'm glad you're honest about that. Finally, do you consider yourself creative or unimaginative?
I wouldn't say creative. I'm not very good at writing or painting, that sort of thing.
I think your creative. But if you don't think so, I'll put down unimaginative.
